name: group.agitech/site-check
title: Agitech Site Check
description: Website and AI visibility checks: speed, SEO, security, accessibility, content, AI recommendations

tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Checks a public website from the outside, like a visitor: speed on a phone, search (SEO), security, accessibility and content. Returns a score from 0 to 100 for each and the findings, most serious first. Takes up to a minute; if it is not finished, call get_check_results with the check_id. A check of the same website is reused for 24 hours. Free.

website.description: The website address, for example yourcompany.com.

business_name.description: The business's name, if you know it.

country.description: Two-letter code of the main country the business serves, for example AE, AU, GB or US. Used for search rankings and ChatGPT's answers.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Asks ChatGPT up to three questions a potential customer would ask, and reports for each whether the business was named or its site linked, and which businesses were named instead. Also checks whether AI tools can read the site. Write the questions yourself: short, like a real customer, naming the city or country when known, and never naming the business; ask the person what the business sells and where if you don't know. Takes up to a minute. Two checks per website per day. Free.

website.description: The website address, for example yourcompany.com.

questions.description: Up to three questions a customer would ask an AI assistant, for example 'Who are the best commercial cleaners in Dubai?'

business_name.description: The business's name, if you know it.

country.description: Two-letter code of the main country the business serves, for example AE, AU, GB or US. Used for search rankings and ChatGPT's answers.

tools.name: get_check_results
tools.description: Gets the results of a check that was still running, by its check_id. Waits up to 40 seconds for it to finish.

tools.name: email_me_the_full_report
tools.description: Asks the Agitech team for a full written audit of the website: six checks, what to fix first and why, reviewed by a person and sent by email. Only use this when the person asks for it and gives their own name and work email. Their name, email and website go to Agitech, who may get in touch about the report. Nothing is sent to them until the team has reviewed it.

website.description: The website address, for example yourcompany.com.

email.description: The person's own work email, where the report should go.
